cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 63% of energy names green

cards.headline: Shale & E&P leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Shale & E&P at +3.57%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.18%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at -14.81%
cards.body: Leaders: AR +5.79%, EQNR +5.10%, OVV +4.66%, APA +4.38%, TRGP +4.37%. Laggards: EOSE -14.81%, LEU -9.29%, FLNC -9.18%, OKLO -6.70%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
